segments.text: - The Fussy Younger Sister
Just like her older brother, she’ll be attending the St. Francesca academy starting this spring with their childhood friend Yuika who's already a student of this academy since her first year.
Unlike her brother, she’s very serious when it comes to studies and lifestyle choices, but the two of them still get along great when going shopping and stuff like that.
Used to be sensitive and obedient when she was younger, but is starting to get more complex now that she’s older. She’s quite girlish, but she also has a strange love for B-grade horror flicks.
She is very friendly with her classmate Sonya, they are already inseparable.

Despite her small size and young age, she is exceptionally brave and courageous. Umi has only one fear: that Akihito no longer considers her as his little sister if he remembers the truth about who she really is.
Contrary to what Umi reveals, she remains a very intelligent and smart girl. She, for example, quickly realized that Yuika was only "pretending" to have no romantic feelings for Akihito.

大らかな主人公とは逆で、きっちりとした真面目な性格だが、一緒に買い物に出かけたりと兄弟の仲はとてもよい。
小さな頃から素直で感受性豊だったが、最近は年頃のせいか時に複雑な反応をすることも。

segments.text: - The Academy’s #1 Lady
Going unnoticed by no one at St. Francesca Academy, Fuyurugi is the sempai everyone looks up to. She uses an archaic style of speech, and carries herself in a cool and gracious way.

Due to her strict personality, she can sometimes be too serious about things, but she sometimes has trouble handling her finances. The head of the kendo club, she’s pretty much at a genius level when it comes to kendo and hasn’t lost a single match for several years.
She is a relative of Ririka (that she likes a lot) and of Hirotsugu who is also her childhood friend.
In her route, after having confess her feelings to Akihito, she learns that her father and Hirotsugu's father arrange their wedding and that they are engaged.
Kisaya is a constant inner conflict between her duty to her family and the importance of her own feelings but she remains an honest woman with herself and isn't the type to not express her opinions.

segments.text: - The Carefree Childhood Friend

Childhood friend of Akihito and Umi, she also went to the same junior high and high school as they did. She is a spontaneous and easy-going girl, cheerful all year round and liked by everyone. Not very good at sports, but excellent at studying. From a rather rich family, but still likes to challenge herself and find new types of cooking to experiment with.

She was Akihito’s first love, but his confession ended in disaster, and they ended up just staying friends instead. When Akihito meets her again, she’s just the same as back then, and he still has no idea if she knows how he felt for her.

In her route, Akihito reconfirms his feelings to Yuika at the same time as Oikawa who confess his feelings to her. Yuika then decides to choose Oikawa instead of Akihito because she thinks that she doesn't have the right to be loved by Akihito. They then start going out together in the city and walking around the parks. However, she can not lie to her feelings and when Oikawa tries to steal a kiss, her eyes start to reflect something that stops his action.

She thinks, indeed, to be the true and only guilty of the death of Umi because they had disputed themselves that day. It is for this reason that she prefers to go out with Oikawa despite her pure love feelings for Akihito.

- The Mysterious Church Sister

With skin so pale as to be pure white, bright blond hair, and blue eyes, Sonya is a girl with a mysterious atmosphere about her. She is docile, serious, kind and polite in both manners and speech. One could say she’s a bit like an angel. She doesn’t talk much about herself, however, and may seem a bit introverted. In particular, she avoids talking about her upbringing. She’s good at listening to other people, though, and never complains about it. Not one to usually look anyone in the eye, possibly because she never really got into any kind of group of people. Perhaps that is why she hasn’t had many friends up until now. She is also a nun in training, and thus spends a lot of time cleaning at the local church with her mother Mai.
She is very friendly with her classmate Umi, they are already inseparable.

She is very good at making her own stuffed animals. She always makes two copies, one representing the mother and the other representing her daughter. She also likes to visit young orphans to make shows with her stuffed animals.

She lost her father more than 10 years ago and her mother forcibly returned to Italy because her father (Sonya's grandfather) wanted her to return to him. Sonya was adopted by Mai when she was 4, but she almost never calls her "mom".
透けるような白い肌と、色素の薄い金髪碧眼のミステリアスな雰囲気を持つイタリア人。
性格は基本的には控えめでおとなしい。自分からは、あまり話しかけてくることはないので、何を感がているか読めない感じはある。
他人との関わりを避けているのか、あまり親しい友人はいない。クラスメイトの羽未は、唯一の例外で、羽未と雰囲気が似ている主人公には比較的馴染み易かったようだ。
落ち着いた様子とは裏腹に可愛らしいものが好き。

透けるような白い肌と、色素の薄い金髪碧眼の神秘的な雰囲気を持つ少女。性格は基本的には控えめでおとなしい。真面目で、優しく、礼儀正しく、言葉づかいも丁寧。まさに天使のような少女。その反面、自分からは、あまり話しかけてくることはなく、内向的に見えがち。特に、自分の生い立ちについては話したがらない。本人は、人の会話を聞いたり、聞き役に回る方を好んでいるので、不満はない。 目に見えて人を避けたりはしていないが、あまり、グループに属したり、人の輪の中に入っていこうとはしなかった。そのために、今まで特定の友人というものはない。また、シスター見習いとして、教会の掃除やはとに餌をやったりしている。羽未と友達になったことで、羽未のバイトしている黎明館に出入りするようになり、忙しそうな時などを中心にお手伝いのつもりで、ヘルプではいるようになる。人形作りが趣味で、寮の部屋は人形だらけになっている。

segments.text: - The Always Cheerful Classmate

She sits next to Akihito in class, and their relationship starts out as that of two friends who both think highly of themselves. She’s got a bright personality and she’s very energetic, plus she’s a member of the swimming club. There are times when she’s kind and times when she’s cold, making her a rather moody person. Riru loves cute girls, and she often gets into arguments with Akihito when she talks about it. There are even times when she says mean things to Akihito or makes fun of him on purpose. She’s from a hardworking family, and she does her best every day to improve her cooking and candy making skills.
She is madly in love with her senpai Reika since she met her the day she arrived at the swimming club with her friend Yuuki.

In her route, thanks to Akihito who became her best friend and confidant, she finds the courage to confess her feelings to Reika and they start dating. However, Akihito realizes his feelings for Riru, Riru depresses because her best friend doesn't speak to her anymore and things take another turn.

segments.text: - The Generous Onee-sama

Ayaka is the friend of Reika and a "very long time" friend of Satsuki. She is a calm and gentle third-year student. She’s a family-oriented girl who loves reading and cooking. She meets Akihito when he finds an abandoned puppy. Ayaka often reads books in the courtyard, and smiles when Akihito comes to talk to her. She’s supposedly a member of the art club, but she usually doesn’t attend the club’s activities.
Akihito is charmed by her kindness when she brings him a homemade bento.
However, even Akihito gets perplexed when she gets overly sensitive about family matters and paintings.
Reika often compares the relationship between Satsuki and Ayaka as being similar to that between a legal guardian and his adopted child.

Ayaka is very assertive with Akihito, she's pretty "touchy" with him; she often takes his hand, resting against his shoulder or letting him rest on her thighs. She also invites him to walk with Orange (her dog) and also invites him to eat at her place.

Ayaka has many worries in her life: she suffers from a heart disease that will be fatal to her if she doesn't get surgery (who itself has very little chance of success), she is in very bad terms with her stepmother and her father and she is still recovering from the disappearance of her mother and another person, whom she loved immensely but who died 4 years ago of the same disease as she has.

手作りのお弁当を作ってきてくれたり、さりげない優しさと品の良い仕草に主人公は惹かれていく。
しかし、何故か家族関係のことになると、必要以上に敏感になってしまう。

Akihito and Kazuto's friend at St. Francesca.

All the girls in the school run away from him (with some exceptions) because he is known and reputed to be the greatest of the perverts. He is very unlucky from the romantic point of view because, among the girls who dare to talk to him, none wants to go out with him : "With Oikawa-kun? It's just impossible and inconceivable".

In Yuika's route, he falls in love and confesses his feelings to Yuika at the same time as Akihito. Yuika decides to choose him instead of Akihito. However, he soon realizes that Yuika is always thinking of Akihito during their dates and that her true love feelings are for Akihito but that she conceals them for some obscure reason ...
He then decides to put Akihito's ideas back in place so that he can make Yuika happy.

Akihito is the childhood friend of Yuika and the older brother of Umi. He used to attend another school, named Takamiya Academy, last year until it closed due to financial difficulties. He is the only male student in his class. His class (2-V) is also called "Soleil".

Mai is a nun who's always around the church or at the girl's dorm. She's the mother of Sonya. She's very kind and friendly, very womanly despite having an interesting and original personality. She is the kind of person we love very easily.
He is a relative of Ririka and of Kisaya who is also his childhood friend.

He is very arrogant and manipulative. He doesn't really like Kisaya and only sees his own profit in getting married. He doesn't like Akihito, who's blocking him in his projects and he does not hesitate to use Ririka, forcing her to go and seduce Akihito in the middle of the night, on pain of closing her father's business.
The school nurse. Despite his appearance, he is an adult in his own right. He is very kind and understanding with the students and he is a great lover of tea.
He has several other roles due to lack of staff and also runs the kendo club and manage the Daybreak Cafe.
Akihito and Umi's mother.

Kind and very attentive to the needs of her children. Umi calls her once every weeks and she complains a lot that her son never calls her on his own initiative. She has a good relationship with Yuika whom she considers as her own daughter.
A strange woman who seems to love the same stuffed cows as Umi.
Umi is the real sister of Akihito who died being hit by a car years ago, just a few days before the official adoption of Umi.

Her death shocked Akihito so much that his subconscious replaced the sister who had passed away by his adoptive sister. At the start of the game, he still thinking that Umi (羽未) is his real blood-related sister.
